semantic_candidates.evidence: One conical face joins coaxial circular sections of radii 5 and 12 millimetres over a 25-millimetre axial height, with a planar cap at each end.

validation_findings.evidence: Both cap radii are positive and the seam generatrix has length sqrt(25^2+7^2) millimetres.
The two cap boundaries have exact circle curves and the seam generatrix has an exact line curve.
The full conical U interval identifies its endpoints and uses one generatrix edge twice on the lateral wire.
Both trimming circles have nonzero radii, so the mathematical cone apex lies outside the retained lateral interval.
The no-processing STEP round trip records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
Each circular edge joins one cap to the conical face and the seam is used in both directions by the full-periodic lateral wire.
The conical lateral face and two caps form one connected boundary with exactly two incident face uses per edge.
V-E+F equals 2-3+3=2 and excluding the apex prevents a collapsed boundary.

oracle.statement: A full frustum between radii 5 and 12 millimetres has one periodic conical face, two planar circular caps, two closed circular boundary edges, and one seam generatrix. The two cap seam vertices and two uses of every edge yield the stated unique and occurrence counts; the positive end radii exclude the cone apex.
